summary.text: Son of Hyperasius from Pella, Macedonian Argonaut — not to be confused with Deucalion the survivor of the Flood.

story.text: Hyginus names a Deucalion son of Hyperasius from Pella among the Minyae; he must be kept distinct from the Deucalion who refathered mankind after the Flood.

Hyginus' 'Pella' must not be read as the later Macedonian capital: the same catalogue pairs Hyperasius' sons Asterion and Amphion with Pellene in Achaea, not with any Thessalian or Macedonian polis attested in Apollodorus or Apollonius. No source in our corpus ties this Deucalion to a named city on our map — residence stays deferred.
